shortDescription: Ethereum could trigger $692 million in cumulative long liquidations across major centralized exchanges if it falls below $2,563, according to Coinglass data. According to ChainCatcher, if ETH rises above $2,807, cumulative short liquidation pressure on major CEXs would reach $685 million.
